assets.name: league-gold.png
assets.prompt:
Premium 3D mobile game league badge, AAA quality, like a high-end ranked-mode emblem. Polished real metal with
crisp bevels and sharp specular highlights, deep glossy enamel, small cut gems that catch the light, a thin
bright rim light along the top edges, soft ambient occlusion in the recesses. Bright, rich and clean, never
dark, dirty or muddy. One single object, perfectly symmetrical, centred, facing straight at the camera
(orthographic front view, no tilt), filling about 85% of the frame. Transparent background, no cast shadow,
no floor, no glow halo outside the object. Original design, not based on any existing game or brand. No text,
no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark.

A heraldic shield badge in polished warm yellow gold with a thick rounded rim, its face a deep royal blue
enamel. In the middle sits a big faceted gold five-pointed star with a round ruby set in its centre. A small
gold crown with three pearl-tipped points sits on top of the shield, and two swept gold wings spread from its
upper sides. Small sapphires are set along the rim. Triumphant, precious and celebratory.

Use case: stylized-concept. Single isolated 1024x1024 square league badge, genuine transparent background. The whole shield, crown and BOTH wings must fit fully inside the frame, with a consistent clear margin on every side. All components form one connected, front-facing, bilaterally symmetric silhouette. Exactly three pearl-tipped crown points. No glow or colored haze outside the metal.
